workflow issue-followup, version 1

when a Slack message is posted in acme/slack, in conversation C0123
match text exists

flow, at most 4 runs an hour, 1 at a time
  events in acme as issue-followup, run emits finished
  on raised acme.client-asks.issue.created and acme.client-asks.run.failed, within 2 hours
  step known: if trigger.outputs.issue.identifier exists
    no → end
  step tell: tell me "{{trigger.outputs.issue.identifier}} was made for a message in acme/slack"
    emits notified

keep text
at most 60 an hour
